technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with price above all major MAs and bullish indicators, but extreme RSI9 overbought (81.64), declining RSI momentum, and lack of fresh crossover signals indicate high exhaustion risk and poor swing entry timing.

fundamental.summary: CSGP shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 42 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity (junior member, small amounts, net sales) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels (304), strong dollar pressures multinationals, CPI event imminent, and real estate sector faces credit stress in tightening environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (21/100) and contrarian buy signal present asymmetric risk/reward opportunity if macro conditions stabilize, with support at 77.45 providing defined downside.
debate.key_bear_argument: RSI9 at 81.64 with declining momentum, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, imminent CPI event, zero fundamental support, and price below 50SMA/200EMA create a perfect storm of exhaustion and macro headwinds that overwhelm any contrarian appeal.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI9 overbought (81.64) with declining momentum and price below TEMA/DEMA signal exhaustion risk at resistance; macro environment (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, imminent CPI) provides no tailwind for swing entry despite contrarian fear sentiment.
decision.primary_risk: RSI9 exhaustion combined with macro headwinds (inverted curve, VIX 304, strong dollar) creates high probability of sharp pullback or breakdown before any contrarian bounce materializes.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish conviction; technical exhaustion, fundamental weakness, and macro crisis all point to AVOID
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 34 Real Estate positions and existing CSGP position; sector concentration and ticker overlap further reduce conviction and sizing capacity.
